cohort: Women who gave birth at a hospital in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, India, between January 2015 and December 2016 and were diagnosed with cerebral venous thrombosis.
finding: The incidence of puerperal CVT in the study population was 125.8 per 100,000 deliveries, with headache being the most common presenting symptom (100%), followed by seizure (66.6%).
